programs.name: Master of Science in Urban Forestry

academic.text: A bachelor's degree from a recognised institution in related fields such as Forestry, Ecology, Biology, Horticulture, Agriculture, Arboriculture, Landscape Management, Geography, Landscape Studies, Environmental Management, Turfgrass Science, Landscape Architecture, and Environmental Science (or equivalent).
academic.quote: A bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution in related fields like Forestry, Ecology, Biology, Horticulture, Agriculture, Arboriculture, Landscape Management, Geography, Landscape Studies, Environmental Management, Turfgrass Science, Landscape Architecture, and Environmental Science (or equivalent); or

prerequisites.text: Putonghua language requirement: mother tongue/language is Putonghua.
prerequisites.quote: Mother tongue/ language is Putonghua; or

prerequisites.text: Putonghua language requirement: bachelor's degree or above with Putonghua as the medium of instruction.
prerequisites.quote: Received a bachelor’s degree or above of which the MOI was Putonghua; or

prerequisites.text: Putonghua language requirement: at least three years working experience in Chinese Mainland or other Putonghua speaking countries or regions.
prerequisites.quote: Have at least three years working experience in Chinese Mainland or other Putonghua speaking countries or regions; or

prerequisites.text: Putonghua language requirement: at least Grade B, Level 3 in the Putonghua Shuiping Ceshi awarded by the State Language Commission (SLC).
prerequisites.quote: Have achieved at least Grade B, Level 3 in the Putonghua Shuiping Ceshi awarded by the State Language Commission (SLC); or

prerequisites.text: Putonghua language requirement: demonstrate Putonghua speaking competence through assessments in an interview.
prerequisites.quote: Demonstrate the Putonghua speaking competence through assessments in an interview.

programs.name: Master of Science in Digital Tourism and Hospitality Management

academic.text: A relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent from a recognised institution.
academic.quote: A relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent from a recognised institution; or

prerequisites.text: Putonghua language requirement: mother tongue/language is Putonghua, or the MOI of the bachelor's degree was Putonghua, or at least three years of working experience in Chinese Mainland or other Putonghua speaking countries or regions, or at least Grade B, Level 3 in the Putonghua Shuiping Ceshi, or demonstrated Putonghua speaking competence through an interview assessment.
prerequisites.quote:
4. Language Requirement (Putonghua)
(i)            Mother tongue/ language is Putonghua; or
(ii)           Received a bachelor’s degree or above of which the MOI was Putonghua; or
(iii)          Have at least three years working experience in Chinese Mainland or other Putonghua speaking countries or regions; or
(iv)          Have achieved at least Grade B, Level 3 in the Putonghua Shuiping Ceshi awarded by the State Language Commission (SLC); or
(v)           Demonstrate the Putonghua speaking competence through assessments in an interview.
